events.text: Boat built at Vegesack shipyard for Kriegsmarine service.

events.label: training
events.text: Began warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea.

evidence.quote: She conducted her warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea in the first half of 1942

events.label: sinking
events.text: Sank a small British freighter during her first patrol.

evidence.quote: sinking a small British freighter on 2 August

events.label: sinking
events.text: Sank American tanker Esso Williamsburg with one torpedo during second patrol.

evidence.quote: on 3 October , after twelve days of cruising , she spotted the 11,000 ton American tanker Esso Williamsburg

events.label: sinking
events.text: Sank an unnamed British ship with three torpedoes, all crew aboard.

evidence.quote: This was followed six days later by another success in a similar area

events.label: patrol_departure
events.text: Departed on third patrol after repairs, returning to North Atlantic routes.

evidence.quote: After repairs , U-254 departed in late November 1942

events.label: loss
events.text: Lost in collision with U-221 during attack on Convoy HX 217; crew lost.
